banner.botCredential.notConfigured: The installation bot is not configured yet. Some features will not work until an admin sets it up.
banner.botCredential.invalid: The installation bot's credential is invalid. Please contact an admin.
banner.botCredential.hub-unreachable: Could not reach the Hub to check the installation bot. Please try again later.
banner.assistantNotInRoom.message: The meeting assistant is not a member of this room yet, so it cannot save or process meetings here.
banner.assistantNotInRoom.manual: The app could not add the assistant. Ask a room owner to invite @{slug} to this room, then reopen the app.
screen.new.sourceBrowserHint: Open Remote Browser in this Room and join the call there, then start. The app hears the browser directly: no microphone needed, headphones are fine.
screen.new.voiceprintNotice: This room recognises returning speakers by voice: voices in this meeting may be matched to, and added to, saved voiceprints. Tell participants before you start.
screen.new.micDenied: The browser denied microphone access. Grant mic permission for this page and try again.
screen.new.micError: Could not access the microphone. Check your device and try again.
screen.new.micNotFound: No microphone found on this device. Connect a microphone and try again.
screen.new.micBusy: The microphone is in use by another app or tab. Close it and try again.
screen.new.micUnavailable: This app hasn't been granted microphone access in this room. Ask a workspace admin to approve the app's microphone permission, then reload.
screen.new.startFailed: Microphone is fine, but the meeting couldn't be started. Please try again.
recording.keepAwake.notice: Turn off screen auto-lock/sleep while recording — the Hub has not granted this app the screen-wake-lock permission yet.
recording.capacity.notice: The system is at its maximum concurrent recordings, live captions are temporarily unavailable — recording continues and speaker names will arrive after processing.
recording.browser.no_browser: No shared browser is running in this Room yet. Open Remote Browser and join the call; the app starts listening as soon as it is there.
recording.browser.no_audio: This Room's browser has no sound output yet. Remote Browser needs updating.
recording.browser.busy: Another listener is already reading this browser.
recording.browser.unauthorized: Remote Browser refused the connection. Ask the operator to check the audio key.
recording.upload.pending: {n} recording parts are waiting to upload — keep this tab open and online so they reach the meeting.
recording.upload.lost: {n} recording part(s) could not be uploaded in time and are missing from the meeting's audio. Captions on screen are not affected.
recording.upload.capReached: Too many recording parts are waiting to upload; new audio is being dropped. Check the connection, then end and restart the recording if it does not recover.
recording.upload.recorderError: The browser stopped recording audio. End the recording to keep what was captured, then start a new one.
recording.degradedLabels.notice: Speaker labels will be available after processing.
speaker.linePicker.title: Who spoke this segment?
speaker.linePicker.applyToVoice: Apply to every line of this voice
recording.time.toggle: Toggle time: since start / spoken length
recording.liveSummary.waiting: A running summary appears about {minutes} minutes in, then refreshes every {minutes} minutes.
recording.liveSummary.error: Could not generate the summary. Try again.
recovery.browser.message: "{title}" is being recorded from the Room browser.
processing.title: Processing meeting
processing.backgroundNotice: Processing runs on the server. You can close this tab or start a new meeting — the result will appear in History.
processing.stale: The job has stopped — the server may have restarted.
speaker.resolveModal.title: Confirm speakers
speaker.resolveModal.subtitle: Assign the people who spoke in this meeting so future meetings recognize them automatically.
speaker.resolveModal.enrolDeferredNotice: Named. Their voice sample wasn't clear enough yet to remember automatically — it will improve after this meeting finishes processing.
speaker.resolveModal.enrolNotPermittedNo: Named. The voice sample was not added to an existing profile you did not create — only its creator, the linked person or a workspace admin can add samples to it.
speaker.memberPicker.degradedHint: Member search needs the "rooms:read" permission, which isn't granted yet. Ask an admin to approve it (or re-pair the app); for now just type the name.
speaker.settingsPanel.title: Speaker identification
speaker.settingsPanel.recognitionHint: Voiceprints are biometric data. Turned off, this room computes and stores none: speaker labels come from the speech-to-text provider only, and names you assign are kept without a voice sample.
speaker.settingsPanel.deleteConfirm: Delete this speaker profile and all its voice data? This cannot be undone.
speaker.settingsPanel.thresholdWarning: Changing the threshold only affects meetings processed afterwards.
speaker.settingsPanel.thresholdUnavailab: This setting is not available in this version yet.
speaker.settingsPanel.pruneConfirm: Remove the flagged low-quality voice samples from this profile? This cannot be undone.
recording.speakerChips.label: Who's speaking?
recording.speakerChips.degraded: Some segments could not be identified
speaker.quickAssign.title: Who's speaking?
speaker.quickAssign.notFoundYet: Not enough voice data for this person yet — try again in a few seconds.

sendToChat.noScope: No permission to send messages to the chat room yet.
sendToChat.alreadySent: Already sent to the chat room.
history.deleteConfirm: Delete this meeting? Its audio and transcript on Files will also be deleted. This cannot be undone.
history.rowMenu.label: More actions
detail.audioDeleted: The original audio was deleted per the storage setting
detail.shareCopied: Link to the meeting's folder in Files copied — room members can open it.
detail.shareCopyHint: Copy this link to the meeting folder in Files:
detail.shareUnavailable: Could not build a link to this meeting in Files.

settings.nav.caption: Caption display
settings.agent.title: Room agent
settings.agent.intro: Let the Room's agent record a Google Meet call: it joins with the Room's shared browser (PrivOS Remote Browser) and this app records, captions and summarises. This installs the app's Meeting skill in the Room's agent.
settings.agent.state.ready: The Room's agent has the Meeting skill.
settings.agent.state.outdated: The Room's agent has an older Meeting skill.
settings.agent.state.not-enabled: The Meeting skill is in Agent Factory but not enabled for this Room.
settings.agent.state.missing: The Room's agent does not have the Meeting skill yet.
settings.agent.scopesMissing: PrivOS has not granted this app {scopes} yet. A workspace admin approves it in Admin → Apps → PrivOS Meeting App → permissions, then this page can install the skill.
settings.agent.problem.not-allowed: PrivOS did not allow this: uploading the skill needs a workspace admin, enabling it a Room owner.
settings.agent.problem.collocated: This Room's Sandbox runs in shared mode, which cannot load skills. Ask a workspace operator to switch it to dedicated mode.
settings.agent.problem.failed: Installing the skill failed. Try again.
settings.agent.exampleStop: @agent stop recording and send the summary
settings.agent.exampleStart: @agent join https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij and record the meeting
settings.adminOnlyNote: Only the room's owners and moderators, or a workspace admin, can change this setting.
settings.language.title: Language & translation
settings.language.meetingLanguage: Main meeting language (default for a new meeting)
settings.language.hint: A segment already in the target language is never translated again. This is only the default for a new meeting — it can be changed again when you start recording.
settings.speech.title: Speech recognition (STT)
settings.speech.noApiKeyNote: There is no API key field here — keys are configured by an admin as server environment variables.
settings.speech.localProvider: Built-in (Vietnamese + English, audio stays in the workspace)
settings.speech.elevenlabsRealtimeWarnin: Speaker labels will be available after processing (ElevenLabs has no live labels).
settings.speech.changeAppliesToNewMeetin: A change only affects a meeting started after saving.
settings.speech.keyNote: API keys are configured by an admin as server environment variables.
settings.speech.memberDown: Live captioning is currently unavailable — recording still works normally.
settings.speech.adminOnly: Only the room's owners and moderators, or a workspace admin, can see the details and change the provider.
settings.microphone.title: Microphone
settings.microphone.permission.denied: Microphone access was denied — re-grant it in the browser.
settings.microphone.permission.prompt: The browser will ask for microphone access when you start recording or testing.
settings.aiSummary.title: AI summary
settings.aiSummary.modelHint: The summary model (SUMMARY_MODEL) is configured by an admin on the server.
settings.privacy.title: Privacy & storage
settings.privacy.autoDeleteDays: Auto-delete audio after N days (0 = off)
settings.privacy.interruptedPartsDays: Clean up interrupted meeting parts after N days
settings.privacy.autoDeleteMeetingsDays: Delete whole meetings (transcript, summary, audio, voice samples) after N days — 0 keeps them
settings.privacy.deleteAllWarning: Deletes every speaker profile in the workspace — cannot be undone. Future meetings will stop auto-recognizing anyone.
settings.captionDisplay.title: Caption display
detail.audioUnavailable: The recording can't be played here right now. The transcript and summary are unaffected.
screen.new.localLanguageHint: The built-in recognizer understands Vietnamese and English. For other languages, an admin can switch this room to Soniox or ElevenLabs in Settings › Speech recognition.
settings.speech.section.realtimeHint: What everyone sees on screen while the meeting runs.
settings.speech.section.asyncHint: The full transcript with speakers, which the summary is written from.
settings.speech.vendor.local.name: Built-in
settings.speech.vendor.local.realtime: Runs on this workspace’s server, so audio never leaves it. Vietnamese and English, even mixed in one sentence.
settings.speech.vendor.local.async: Runs on this workspace’s server: transcribes and tells speakers apart without sending audio anywhere.
settings.speech.vendor.soniox.name: Soniox
settings.speech.vendor.soniox.realtime: Cloud service with 60+ languages that labels who is speaking while they talk.
settings.speech.vendor.soniox.async: Cloud service with 60+ languages and speaker separation.
settings.speech.vendor.elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
settings.speech.vendor.elevenlabs.realti: Cloud service with many languages; speakers are labelled only after the meeting.
settings.speech.vendor.elevenlabs.async: Cloud service with many languages and speaker separation.
settings.speech.needsKey: Needs an API key on the server (set by an admin).
settings.aiSummary.liveHint: Hub AI summarizes what has been said so far, with the action items, in the side panel of the live screen.
settings.aiSummary.autoSend: Post the summary to the room chat when it is ready
settings.aiSummary.autoSendHint: Posted once per meeting by the app’s bot, with a link to summary.md in Files. Needs the “Send messages” permission; without it the “Send to chat” button stays.
recording.liveSummary.waitingManual: Press Refresh to summarize what has been said so far.
actionItems.type.question: Question
ask.label: Question about this meeting
ask.hint: Answers come only from what was said in the meeting, with the lines they rest on. Nothing is stored unless you save it.
ask.empty: For example: Who is sending the quote? Which release date was agreed?
ask.nothingYet: There are no captions to answer from yet.
ask.noTranscript: Questions are available once the meeting has been processed.
notes.label: Your notes for this meeting
notes.hint: Saved automatically to notes.md in Files, and taken into account by the summary.
